content: Ngkartele Jesus ilwekarle-ngentyele itethe-ilirtneme

Arlte Saturday aneke arlte apurrke Jew areye-kenhe-arle, itne urrkapetyakenhe aneke ingwele anteme-irreke urrkapetye-kwenye akwete. Itne ankwe inteke arlte arrpenhe anteme-irreke. Kele Mary Magdala-arenye, Salome, Mary, mikwe James-kenhe-arlke, uterne akertne-irretyakenhe-nge akwete alherlte-iweke, atyalangke Jesus-kenhe antere ntyentyele apernewarretyeke, inteye kwene-werne irrpenherlte-iweke.

Itne alherlte-iwemele angkeke, “Angwenhele-ame apwerte athirnte akngerre-apenhe renhe ankerte-iwetyenhe nhenge arriwele ilpeme inteye renhe anwerne-ketyenge?” Itne uyarne anthurre itirreke apwerte nhenge-arle akngerre anthurre anekenge. Ikwere-irretye-alhemele itne areke arrpenhele apwerte athirnte akngerre-apenhe renhe ankerte-iwekenge itere-werne, yanhe ikwerele tnetyame.
Inteye-werne irrpenheke-arle iperre, itne arerrirreke artwe mantere mperlkere-akerte akwe-arratyele anerle-anerlenge. Itne renhe areke-arle-iperre atere-irrerirremele.

Utnenge alkere-arenye anteme arelhe urrpetyeke angkeke, “Atere-irrerirretyalaye! The itelareme arrantherre-arle Jesus-eke apale untheme, nhenge itne renhe nail-ele arne arntarlkweke-arleke irlpare arrerneke. Ikwere nhenhe arrangkwe! Rarle itethe-irrirtneke akeme-irremele. Itelaraye, re arrekantherre arrekwele ileke, ilwekarle iperrele, rarle itethe-irremele akeme-irretyenhe. Aretyeke apetyewarraye nthenhele-arle re inteke.” Itne arratye irrpenhemele areke imerte angkemele, “Arratye! Nhenhe-arle arrangkwe-arle!”

Utnenge alkere-arenye re anteme itneke alakenhe angkeke, “Iparrpe alperlte-iwaye apententye akngerre ikwerenhe areyeke iletyeke alakenhe, ‘Rarle ilweke iperre itethe akeme-irreke. Re Galilee-werne alheme arrekantherrenge arrekwele, kele arrantherre renhe yanheke-arle aretye-alhetyenhe, rarle arrekantherre ileke-arteke.’ Alakenhe itneke iletyeke alherlte-iwaye!”
Itne arrewemele inteye-ngentyele arratintyeke, apatemele unterlte-iweke. Arrpenheke iletyakenhe aneke atere-arle itne awelhekenge.

Ayeye arrpenhe Jesus-arle arrateme-akerte tyerrtye areyeke irrerlknge-arle aneke-iperrele 16:9 Ayeye arrpenhe nhenhe Jesus-arle itethe-irrirtneke-akerte. Artwe arrpenhele-arle ayeye nhenhe ileke, Mark-ele kwenye.
Jesus Mary Magdala-arenyeke arrateme

Kenhe Jesus ilweke-arle iperre itethe akeme-irreke ingwele-athnele arlte Sunday-nge, re Mary Magdala-arenyeke-amparre arrateke. Nhenge arelhe yanhele akenhe atnyenetyarte arrentye seven-pele akurne. Kenhe Jesus-ele arrentye ikwerenge-ntyele aywepeke re mwerre-irreke.
Mary Magdala-arenyele aretye-alheke apententye akngerre Jesus-kenhe areye akayale artnerlenge, re itneke angkeke,
“The kwenhe artwe Jesus renhe arerne itethe-arle-irreke akeme-irrerlenge.” Kenhe itne ikwere akangkwe-irretyakenhe-arle rarle akwele urrtyirreke-arlenge.
Jesus apententye akngerre ikwerenhe atherreke arrateke
Arlte arrpenhele, Jesus arrateke anteyeke apententye akngerre ikwerenhe atherreke ratherre-arle apmere arrpenhe-werne alherretyamenge.
Kenhe renhe arerle-anerreke-arle-iperre ratherre alperreke, iletye-alpeke arrpenhe areyeke rarle ikwere-atherre arrateke. Kenhe itne akenhe itirreke ratherre-arle urrtyirrekeke-athene.
Jesus apententye akngerre eleven-pele ikwerenhe areyeke arrateme

Kenhe urreke Jesus arrateke apententye akngerre eleven-peleke, merne arlkwerlte-anerlenge. Re itneke ahele-irreke itne-arle itirretyakenhenge rarle itneke arratye ilekenge. Kenhe itne ipmentye awemele aneke nthakenhe-arle tyerrtye areye ikwere-akerte angkerlenge, nhenge tyerrtye areyele-arle renhe areke itethe-irrirtnerlenge.
Kenhe re apententye akngerre areyeke angkeke, “Kele alherlte-iwaye apmere arrpe-anenhe-werne, tyerrtye ingkirrekeke Ayeye Mwerre ilerlte-apemele.

Angwenhele apeke ayenge apentetyeke itirremele, renhe kwatyeke akwernaye baptise-eme-iletyeke. Kenhe Ngkartele renhe itetheke mpwaretyenhenge. Kenhe arrpenhele apeke ayenge ipmentyele-iwetyeke itirreme, Ngkartele renhe ilwetyeke mpwareme.

Tyerrtye nhenge areyele ayenge apentetyeke itirremele, itne arne mwerre areye ilyernpenye mpwaretyenhe. Itne arrentye areye aywepetyenhe arritnye atyinhe atniwemele. Itne angkentye arrpenhe areye angketyenhe-anteye.

Itne apeke ularele-kwenye apmwe arrengkwelthe-akerte kutyetyenhe, kwatye akurne apeke ularele-kwenye antywetyenhe arne arrengkwelthe-akerte, itne ilwetyakenhe anetyenhe. Itne rlkerte areye anpetyenhe, Ngkartele itnenhe angkwerre-iwetyenhenge.”
Jesus alkere akertne-werne alheme
Kenhe Jesus Alartetye-arle itneke angkeke iperre, Ngkartele anteme renhe alkere akertne-werne akngirtneke. Re Ngkartenge akwe-arratyele arrernelheke.

Kenhe apententye akngerre ikwerenhe areye alhemele angkentye mwerre ilerlte-apeke. Itne arne mwerre atningke ilyernpenye mpwareke, Ngkarte-arle itnekenge alhekenge ulyeyele mpwaretyeke. Kenhe tyerrtye areyele aremele itne itelaremele angkeke, “Yewe, tyerrtye nhenhe areyele ayeye arratye anthurre ileme.”
Ayeye arrpenhe-anteye nhenhe aneme Jesus-arle itethe-irrirtneke-akerte, artwe arrpenhele-arle intelhe-ileke, Mark-ele kwenye
Kenhe arelhe areye anteme alheke anyente-irretyeke Peter-kenhe areyenge. Itneke ileke Jesus-arle itethe-irrirtneke, re akenhe Galilee-werne-arle alheke.

Kenhe Jesus-ele yerneke apententye akngerre ikwerenhe areye angkentye mwerre iletyeke apmere arrpe-anenhele nhenge Ngkartele itnenhe itetheke mpwaretyenhenge ikwerenge akwete-ante anetyenhenge. Kele arratye itne alhemele ilerlte-apetyame.
